title: Shinonome Akito — Unyielding Resolve〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Live House
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Whew... I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We somehow managed to win the event, but we still have a lot of work to do...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we're still basically just shouting whenever we're backed into a corner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Singing our lungs out is always fun, but it would be nice to not be out of breath at the end of each performance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Still, each event has its own unique feel... We'll just have to keep performing in them in order to figure out how to strike a balance between our power and stamina.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
I'm gonna go see one of the other teams again before we leave.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Huh? Again?
But we talked to them on our way in.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is there someone you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
An old acquaintance from Vivid Street.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?! You're kidding, right?!
I didn't recognize anyone...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You probably don't know him.
We're talking about the first few months after I began singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But...we ended up in a few events together after I decided to start performing in events. He gave me advice when I had no idea what I was doing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really...? Then, that sort of makes him your mentor. Please go see him!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, hey. Nice performance today.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line: Hey, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line: Wait, Akito?! What's up...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, long time no see.
You seem good.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line: Yeah, never better! As you can tell!

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line:
You seem good too.
You're with Vivid BAD SQUAD now, right...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you know about us?

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line:
Dude...
Don't play dumb after the show you guys put on.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line: To be fair, I didn't realize it was you up there at first.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line: I'd heard that you joined a team and got a lot better, but I honestly thought you were someone else until just now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Someone else? Quit pulling my leg.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line: No, it's proof that you've come a really long way! Take it as a compliment!

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line: Still, what are you guys doing way out here? What happened to your dream of surpassing RAD WEEKEND? Don't tell me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I haven't given up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We've been performing in various different cities as practice in order to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line:
That's great to hear!
I was really worried for a second there...

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line: I don't know how things have been for you back in that place...

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line: But you must've worked really hard in order to get this good, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Well...

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line: Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line:
What was that?
Your hard work is paying off. You should be happier.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I should be allowed to react however I want.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line:
What? Don't give me that...
Actually, never mind. I hope we get to perform together at another event.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Me too. But we're still gonna win.

rows.Speaker: Older Musician
rows.Line:
Haha. That's pretty big talk!
Good luck surpassing RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We will. Thank you again for today.
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's been so long since I last saw him, but he hasn't changed one bit.)

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Backstage
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Welcome back.
What did you guys talk about?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Not much in particular.
We basically just said hi to each other.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's all.?
But, you...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: You seem kinda happy for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, I know. Something good just happened, right? You should tell us all about it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, tell us!
We wanna hear what happened!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Chill out, you guys...
Nothing happened. Honest.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Man...
I really shouldn't be letting my guard down like this...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Akito. Next time, sing with that feeling in mind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now, go unleash everything you just felt! Pow!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'll try to remember this feeling.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And one day...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'll use it as fuel to propel myself to new heights.)
